title: Plain-language questionnaire study
text: This study asks you to complete one short questionnaire. Taking part is voluntary. You may stop at any time. There are no expected physical risks. The study team will keep your answers private.
description: Short synthetic example for UI demonstration; not an expert-labelled benchmark.

title: Chronic-pain treatment study
text: Purpose: The purpose of this study is to evaluate a new treatment for chronic pain. Procedure: If you choose to participate, you will receive the study medicine through a vein every two weeks for twelve weeks. Benefits: The treatment may improve pain symptoms, but there is no guarantee that you will benefit. Risks: Possible adverse events include nausea, dizziness, bleeding, infection, and other risks that are not fully understood. Some risks may be serious or life-threatening. Alternatives: You may choose standard treatment, another available treatment, or no treatment. Monitoring: Your health will be monitored during treatment and follow-up visits. Voluntary participation: Taking part is voluntary. You may refuse to participate or withdraw at any time without affecting your usual medical care. You may ask questions before or during the study.
description: Longer synthetic demo covering several core consent elements.

title: Technical oncology wording
text: The investigational product may produce adverse events including hemodynamic instability, myocardial ischemia, immunogenicity, and complications of uncertain incidence. The pharmacokinetics and prophylactic efficacy will be assessed as specified in the protocol. Participation is voluntary, and the participant may discontinue participation.
description: Synthetic jargon-heavy example; category is only for demo navigation and is not a clinical ground truth label.

title: Missing alternatives and autonomy
text: Purpose: This study evaluates a new questionnaire. Procedure: You will complete three forms during one visit. Risks: Some questions may cause discomfort. Benefits: There may be no direct benefit. Monitoring: A research coordinator will check the forms for missing answers.
description: Synthetic example intentionally missing autonomy and alternatives language.

title: Conditional pregnancy disclosure
text: Purpose: The purpose is to evaluate a medicine used off-label for this condition. Procedure: You will take the medicine once each day. Risks: The medicine may cause side effects that are not fully understood. Benefits: It may improve symptoms, but no benefit is guaranteed. Alternatives: Other treatments or no treatment may be options. Monitoring: The care team will monitor your health. Voluntary participation: You may refuse or withdraw without affecting your usual care. Pregnancy: The medicine may affect pregnancy or an unborn child. Off-label use: This medicine is not approved for this condition.
description: Synthetic conditional example; applicability should be selected in the UI.
